description: Landsat Collection 2 Level-2 clips (SR blue/green/red/nir08/swir16/swir22, ST lwir11 [Landsat 7: lwir/ST_B6], QA_PIXEL), CONTEXT box, native CRS and 30 m grid of each scene (EPSG:32611 or 32612; no resampling), DN unscaled. Folder per <date>_<platform>; files prefixed pPPPrRRR because the AOI straddles WRS-2 rows 024/025 (several path/rows per date possible; many partial). 6 scenes are Earth-Search-only (STAC + meta, no pixels): 2025-12-31 L8 p042r025, 2024-12-28 L8, 2024-12-20 L9, 2024-05-02 L8 (x2), 2023-10-12 L7.
